data.item: CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT Dear Shareholders, In presenting the annual report and financial statements of your company for the year ended 31st December 2008, I take pleasure in reporting that this has been a good year for Housing Finance. During the year we started to realize the results of the strategies we have been pursuing in the last two years as highlighted in some details in the Managing Directors report. However, I would like to mention a few of these welcome signals emerging from the strategies in the reporting year, and restructuring efforts of the last few years. Financial Results In many ways 2008 was a very successful year for the company in financial terms. We reported a growth in pre-tax profits to KShs 203 million, up from Kshs 113 million in 2007. This happened despite the challenges experienced early in 2008 which impacted adversely on the general business environment, including Housing Finance. It is gratifying to note that the company managed to weather the storms and post a good profit. There are encouraging signals that this trend will continue into the future and we expect the Company to make even better results this year. The good results demonstrate that Housing Finance has the potential to deliver materialization of the hopes and dreams that you have been looking for. Strategic Direction As I informed you last year our vision ‘To be the leading provider of integrated solutions for the acquisition, development and improvement of property in Kenya’ is now fully entrenched in the operations of the company. The revival of Kenya Building Society is well on track, and the Property Point has become a profitable centre for the group and an important link for buyers and sellers of property in Kenya. Mortgage remains the core business of Housing Finance and this too retains its market leader position. HHFF AAnnnnuuaal l RReeppoorrtt && FFiinnaanncciiaal l SSttaatteemmeennttss 22000088 88
